response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), 'Missing') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY 1), shares AS (SELECT hand, tally, CAST(tally AS REAL) / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.hand, s.tally, s.share FROM shares s, avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(above.tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(above.share) AS avg_share, AVG(above.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM above, avg_share a;
